verdict.rationale: Community evidence suggests an earlier Cactus build vendored llama.cpp, which implies a GGUF-based runtime. Its demo app offered GGUF model links for Jan Nano and SmolLM3, and those downloads worked, but the app crashed as soon as the models were selected. Current first-party material only describes an experimental `cactus convert` path from HuggingFace and never mentions GGUF. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of GGUF loading, evidence that GGUF models actually run without crashing, and clarity on whether the current engine still supports GGUF.
